correctness.rationale: Read pinned RESULT.md and verify.py. Directed arc faces have exactly the forbidden forward/backward pairs |i-j|<=1; all cycles on an underlying path are two-cycles. Reflection sends p_i to q_{n-1-i}, leaving two tails of admissible two-arc orbits; opposite tail conflict is |i+j-(n-1)|<=1. Equal barycentric coordinates give a PL identification with Ind(B(t)), rather than a naïve vertex-fixed subcomplex. The neighborhood-dominance fold N(L_0)⊆N(L_1), then N(H_0)⊆N(H_1), removes indices one-by-one, isolating an edge and recursing t→t-2; the resulting disjoint-edge independence complex is a cross-polytope boundary. Smith/Caputi--Collari ambient rank-one homology plus integral simplicial Lefschetz trace yields (-1)^{a+b}; explicit modular signs check. Independently computed Euler for all orbit graph faces t=1..6. Finite checks do not substitute for the fold proof.
